title: Elderly Man and Robot Fishing
description: An elderly man with a long white beard, wearing a green coat and hat, walks with a cane along a cracked road at the water's edge, carrying a small blue robot on his back. In a red boat on the water, two figures fish while a glowing all-seeing eye alien face hovers in the greenish sky above.
